read.title: Holiday Gift Guide Opportunity
read.text:
Hi Mia,

We loved your holiday gift guide last year, especially the self-care section. This year, we'd be thrilled if you could feature our new Glow Gift Set.

It comes with a serum, a cream, and a mini mask, and it's priced at $35. We think it's perfect for friends who are new to K-beauty. Our mini lip balm could also work as a stocking stuffer.

We can send both items to you this week. Please let us know if you're interested.

Best,
Minsu
